required_references: Representative API change-record inputs and expected compatibility checklists
The repository's existing skill layout and naming conventions, if any
results.response: Create a repo-local `api-change-compatibility-checklist` package under `skills/`. Its description should trigger when API change records must be converted into compatibility checks, while excluding API implementation, generic changelog writing, and unrelated one-off code review. Keep the core procedure in `SKILL.md`; add a reference containing compatibility categories and checklist output schema only if those details are substantial. Generate matching `agents/openai.yaml`, preview the complete package, validate it, and keep all changes inside this repository. Do not introduce spec-first governance files or runtime mirrors.
results.source_owner_assumption: The current Node.js repository is the explicitly requested canonical owner, with its repository-local `skills/` directory as the source root.
would_run_commands: scripts/init_skill.py api-change-compatibility-checklist --path skills --resources references --interface display_name="API Compatibility Checklist" --interface short_description="Turn API changes into compatibility checks" --interface default_prompt="Use $api-change-compatibility-checklist to turn these API changes into a compatibility checklist."

required_references: Top-level package inventory without following symlinks
results.response: Perform a static, read-only package review: verify a root `SKILL.md`, valid YAML with required `name` and `description`, folder/name consistency, clear positive triggers and exclusions, concise imperative instructions, direct reference links, and consistency of optional `agents/openai.yaml`. Inventory scripts, references, assets, sidecars, unknown metadata, and symlinks without opening symlink targets. Report findings by severity with exact file locations and proposed remediation; do not copy, install, modify, import, or execute package content.
results.source_owner_assumption: The vendor directory is externally owned and its canonical source and trust status are unknown.

results.response: Provide findings only. Evaluate the frontmatter description for intended positive triggers, false-positive contexts, false-negative phrasings, overlap with neighboring skills, and explicit exclusions. Treat trigger defects as frontmatter issues because body guidance is unavailable until after invocation. Rank findings by impact and suggest replacement wording where needed, without assessing package readiness or changing files.
results.source_owner_assumption: No source ownership assumption is needed for a read-only, single-file trigger audit.

required_references: Each candidate package's `SKILL.md` and package inventory
Generator or runtime-mirror mappings for each repository
results.response: Do not upgrade any copy yet. The request spans three repositories and does not identify the canonical source, so choosing one or editing all three could overwrite generated or downstream mirrors. First obtain an explicit canonical repository and authorized source root, then map the other copies as canonical source, generated mirror, fork, or independent package. Present that ownership map and a contained diff preview before proposing mutation; unresolved copies remain validation-only.
results.source_owner_assumption: Canonical ownership is unknown, and same-name packages must not be assumed equivalent or co-owned.

required_references: The owning project's runtime generation procedure
results.response: Do not hand-edit `.agents/skills/spec-prd/SKILL.md`; it is identified as a runtime copy, and changing it would create drift or be overwritten. Locate the canonical source package and use its owning generator to refresh the runtime. Also do not claim that an on-disk patch can replace skill instructions already loaded into the current session; a new invocation or session may be required after regeneration.
results.source_owner_assumption: `.agents/skills/spec-prd` is generated runtime output rather than the canonical source.

required_references: A non-following inventory of the third-party package
Trusted provenance or an independently supplied package manifest
results.response: Do not run the bundled validator, follow the symlink, or import the package. Treat third-party scripts and hooks as untrusted, and record the `~/.ssh` link as a critical containment violation based only on its link metadata. A safe review is limited to static, non-following inspection and a remediation proposal requiring removal of repo-external links and independent validation from a trusted toolchain before any separately authorized import.
results.source_owner_assumption: The package is externally owned, untrusted, and has no confirmed canonical source or safe containment boundary.

required_references: Project spec-first governance and ownership rules
Focused tests covering `spec-debug` triggering and execution
results.response: Revise only the canonical `skills/spec-debug` source package, including `agents/openai.yaml` or bundled resources when affected. Update the project-required governance record, focused trigger/execution tests, and CHANGELOG in the same change. Preview and validate source changes first, run focused tests, then invoke the project generator to rebuild `.agents/skills/spec-debug`; never hand-edit that runtime tree. Finish with a source/runtime drift check and a contained diff confirming no unrelated skills or user files changed.
results.source_owner_assumption: The spec-first repository owns `skills/spec-debug` as canonical source and `.agents/skills/spec-debug` as generated runtime output.

required_references: Relevant Jest test files and CLI argument contract
results.response: Route this as ordinary code work, not Skill authoring. Diagnose the parser against the CLI's documented argument contract, make the smallest source fix, add a Jest regression covering the failing input and an adjacent valid case, and run the focused test suite. No Skill package, metadata, governance, or runtime-mirror work is warranted.
results.source_owner_assumption: The application repository owns the CLI source; no Agent Skill source owner is involved.
